title: Base change before uniformizer reduction
statement: In the standing separated finite-type setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], let g:Yprime→Y and fix the two derived reductions, their CompletionSpec and CycleSystemSpec, the two whole-system diagonal limits, and coefficient families with Reference data as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Given BaseSquares g from [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-source-pullback], there exists NonTorsionPullback: residue-field invertibility on the two projective lines and products, projection-normalized CartesianAdicComparison for baseP and baseW, and PullbackCompatibility at Z_ell, every integral finite extension, every rational finite extension, and the algebraic closure. These use the actual Cartesian root comparisons. No uniformizer-quotient compatibility is asserted.

proof.text: Pull the unit global section ell to each projective line and its self-product, then evaluate in the residue field. IsUnit.map gives residue-field invertibility. Apply Cartesian coefficients along baseP and baseW to obtain the actual normalized adic root comparisons.

Apply completed pullback compatibility to the two given reductions, full diagonal limits and References. This provides the Z_ell class and all three trace squares, including their normalized endpoints.

Propagate that Z_ell comparison through the scalar-compatible Families with the selected Cartesian root comparisons. Choose its integral and rational witnesses for each finite field and its closure witness, and assemble NonTorsionPullback with the already constructed invertibility and root data.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (3): residue invertibility, completed compatibility, then scalar propagation
proof_origin.note: Complete Lean assembly from two strictly smaller geometric/completion and scalar-propagation steps.

mathlib_searches.query: Transport integration identity through a natural transformation and endpoint isomorphisms; canonical right derived functor computed on K injective complexes; diagonal trace coefficient extension and uniformizer quotient annihilation
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj and Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app; none states the normalized diagonal comparison. The canonical K-injective unit API is reused.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No complete existing diagonal coefficient theorem.

mathlib_searches.results: Twelve hits, including rightDerivedUnique and LocalizerMorphism.Derives construction APIs. These provide the canonical unit universal property; they do not assert the geometric coefficient endpoints.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the published universal-property API for the canonical derived model.

mathlib_searches.results: Zero hits in the search service. Local rg of both roots found the definitions of Reference, Family and ScalarCompatibility but no constructions.
mathlib_searches.verdict: New comparison components are necessary for this reduction.

mathlib_searches.query: A cone of root projections followed by free module units induces a map into the inverse limit of integral Tate twists. Coefficient quotient by a regular element commutes with geometric pullback and direct image.
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits concerning adic-completion projections, perfectoid untilts, and inverse limits; no diagonal root-cone or scalar/pullback compatibility theorem.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the ordinary limit universal property and the existing free-module adjunction.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including isLimitOfPreserves and preserves_lift_mapCone. isLimitOfPreserves gives exactly the underlying-module limit used by the root map.
Eighteen Mathlib hits for freeForgetAdjunction, none for the project-specific compatibility structures. Local rg found their definitions but no complete construction.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The project-specific comparison statements are new.

theorem diagonalCoefficient_nonTorsionBaseChange (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (_hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y Y' : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y'.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [IsNoetherian Y'] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y')] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y')]
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] [IsSeparated g]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hY' : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y', ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y']
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y')]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y')]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (_hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (_hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y hY D)
    (D' : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y')))
    (_hcompletion' : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y') D')
    (_hsystem' : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y' hY' D')
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (δ' : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y' ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y')
    (_hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (_hδ' : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y' hY' D' δ')
    (geometry : BaseSquares g)
    (family : Family l Y) (family' : Family l Y')
    (_reference : Reference l Y δ family) (_reference' : Reference l Y' δ' family') :
    Nonempty (NonTorsionPullback l g family family')
